tasks.DefineVariables: Define the number of girls (G) and boys (B) in terms of a multiple of 13 and their sum being 35.
tasks.FormulateEquation: Formulate an equation based on the given conditions, considering G is a multiple of 13 and G > B.
tasks.SolveForBoys: Solve for the number of boys using the formulated equation with the constraint that there are more girls than boys.
tasks.ValidateSolution: Verify the solution satisfies all given constraints.
